prior_gaps.description: There is no direct modern workplace email/chat benchmark in this corpus that jointly annotates speech-act type, owner/assignee, action object, deadline, conditions/exceptions, and exact evidence spans.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: "action item extraction" (email OR Slack OR "workplace chat" OR "enterprise chat") assignee deadline condition "evidence span" corpus
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Still open after rounds 1-2 and the current synthesis. Existing admitted workplace papers cover subsets such as acts, owners, semantic roles, or conversational context, but no paper identified so far supplies a modern authentic workplace email/chat benchmark jointly annotating all target arguments plus exact evidence spans.

prior_gaps.description: Direct empirical evidence for extracting decisions, approvals, rejections, and proposals with structured arguments from authentic workplace email or chat is still missing from this corpus.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: ("decision extraction" OR "decision detection" OR "proposal extraction") ("workplace email" OR "enterprise chat" OR Slack) approval rejection proposal "argument extraction"
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Still open after rounds 1-2 and the current synthesis. The corpus contains work distinguishing action proposals or decisions and work on decision-related discourse, but it does not yet provide direct empirical structured-argument extraction for decisions, approvals, rejections, and proposals in authentic workplace email or enterprise chat.

prior_gaps.description: Owner/assignee extraction remains weakly evidenced, especially for implicit owners, group ownership, multiple actions with different owners, and owners recoverable only from organizational or conversation context.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: ("assignee prediction" OR "assignee extraction" OR "responsibility extraction" OR "action owner") (email OR Slack OR "workplace chat") implicit owner group owner context
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Still open after rounds 1-2 and the current synthesis. Existing evidence establishes that responsibility may be plural, implicit, recipient-external, or role-dependent, but does not close extraction for implicit owners, group assignees, separately owned actions in the same message, or owners requiring organizational/thread context.

prior_gaps.description: The corpus does not establish reliable deadline binding in workplace communication: distinguishing a deadline for a particular action from a merely mentioned date, shared date, scheduling expression, or conditional future time remains open.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: ("deadline extraction" OR "due date extraction" OR "deadline detection") (email OR "workplace communication" OR Slack) "action item" temporal relation event argument
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Still open after rounds 1-2 and the current synthesis. Temporal-relation research indicates that semantic and relational context matters, but no admitted direct workplace study evaluates attachment of a deadline to the correct action against distractor dates, shared dates, scheduling expressions, and conditional future times.

prior_gaps.description: Direct workplace evidence is insufficient for attaching conditions, exceptions, negation, and modality to the correct action when several actions or clauses occur together.
prior_gaps.suggested_search_query: ("conditional commitment" OR "deontic modality" OR "negation scope" OR "condition extraction") (email OR "workplace communication" OR Slack) action attachment obligation
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Still open after rounds 1-2 and the current synthesis. Workplace studies establish that conditional commitments and implicit obligations are difficult, while adjacent-domain work supplies scope mechanisms, but the corpus lacks a direct workplace benchmark for correct condition, exception, negation, and modality attachment across multiple actions or clauses.

prior_gaps.description: Build an independent argument-level benchmark and adversarial fixture suite covering implicit owners, multiple actions in one sentence, shared deadlines, conditional and negated actions, overlapping request/commitment labels, quoted-history contamination, and attachment references; score false positives, false negatives, and each argument separately.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Resolve by constructing a project-owned gold benchmark with an explicit annotation schema for act type, action span, owner, deadline, condition, negation/modality, provenance, and uncertainty. Create targeted adversarial fixtures for every listed failure mode, double-annotate a representative subset to measure agreement, adjudicate disagreements, and implement per-field precision/recall/F1 plus exact-span and whole-structure metrics. Existing papers can seed fixture categories, but resolution requires benchmark construction and execution rather than additional literature.

prior_gaps.description: Compare sentence-local, message-level, and selectively expanded thread-context extraction with controlled ablations, because the literature shows both context gains and context-induced degradation.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Resolve with a controlled benchmark experiment using identical examples, extraction model, prompt/schema, decoding settings, and scoring while varying only available context: target sentence, full message, fixed neighboring messages, and selectively retrieved thread context. Report argument-level and whole-structure accuracy, false-positive/false-negative changes, latency/token cost, and stratified results for cases that genuinely require prior context versus locally resolvable cases.

prior_gaps.description: Test author/quoted/forwarded content zoning while preserving provenance, and measure whether zoning improves act and argument extraction without losing obligations whose interpretation depends on prior-message context.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Resolve by implementing deterministic or model-assisted segmentation of authored text, quoted history, forwarded blocks, signatures, and attachment-reference regions while retaining source-message and span provenance. Run paired evaluation with zoning disabled, zoning used as a hard filter, and zoning retained as tagged context. Measure extraction precision/recall and specifically audit obligations whose correct interpretation depends on quoted or prior-message material.

prior_gaps.description: Evaluate an uncertainty-preserving structured output in which owner, deadline, condition, or act subtype can remain unresolved, and measure whether this reduces false obligations and wrong argument assignments without unacceptable recall loss.
prior_gaps.resolution_notes: Resolve by extending the output schema with explicit unresolved/unknown states and, if supported, calibrated confidence per argument. Compare forced-completion and uncertainty-preserving extraction on the same benchmark. Measure false obligation creation, incorrect owner/deadline/condition attachment, abstention rate, retained recall, calibration, and selective-risk curves across confidence thresholds.
